channel.title: MastermindX Research Blog
channel.description: Plain-English trading education from MastermindX Research.

item.title: Compound Growth for Traders
item.description: Return sequencing and drawdowns dominate long-run CAGR. Why the arithmetic mean of annual returns overstates actual wealth growth and what to use instead.

item.title: Congress Trades Are Not Real-Time Signals
item.description: The STOCK Act gives members of Congress 45 days to disclose trades. By the time you see a filing, the position is weeks old and the context has shifted.

item.title: How to Keep a Trading Journal
item.description: Most trading journals die from friction or vanity metrics. The exact fields that let you compute expectancy, R multiples, and mistake cost per setup.

item.title: The Math of Losing Streaks
item.description: Losing streaks are a mathematical certainty at any realistic win rate. The only question is whether your position sizing lets you survive them.

item.title: Why a 50% Loss Needs a 100% Gain
item.description: Losses and gains are not symmetric. A 50% drawdown requires a 100% return to recover — the math that makes drawdown depth the professional obsession.

item.title: Win Rate Is Overrated
item.description: A 35% win rate can be more profitable than a 70% win rate. Expectancy — not how often you win — determines whether a system makes money.
